proposition: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II is an apology addressed to Bāysunghur, written after Ibn Turka's arrest, imprisonment and exile following the Hurufi attempt on Shāhrukh's life in 830/1427, asking Bāysunghur to mediate an audience with the sultan.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, in Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II
mediation.note: written to an intercessor to obtain a hearing; harsh on Hurufis and on false Sufis
